holdings.name: ICICI Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit increased to ₹17,389 crore for the quarter ended September 2026, with standalone profit at ₹14,843 crore.
The bank's CASA ratio decreased by 340 basis points to 36.1% due to an increase in FCNR (B) deposits.

expected.text: Nomura projected a 17% core PPOP growth in Q2 for leading private banks, including ICICI Bank.

seeing.text: The bank delivered standalone profit of ₹14,843 crore, triggering brokerage upgrades following an earnings beat.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 5.6% fund weight, ICICI Bank is the fund's largest position; its 3-month return of -5.42% contributed -0.304% to performance, reinforcing overall drag in the 29.8% Financials sector.

watch.text: Stabilization of deposit mix following the decline of the CASA ratio to 36.1%.

holdings.name: HDFC Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit for the September 2026 quarter reached ₹21,537 crore, while Deputy MD Kaizad Bharucha's tenure was confirmed to end on December 31, 2026.
The stock declined 2% post-results as brokerages highlighted ongoing margin pressure.

expected.text: Nomura expected 17% core PPOP growth across major private lenders in Q2.

seeing.text: Brokerages reduced price targets citing persistent net interest margin compression despite positive net profit growth.

holdings.why_it_matters: Representing 3.91% of fund assets, the stock fell -8.44% over 3 months, creating an estimated -0.330% drag and compounding weakness across top banking holdings.

watch.text: The strategic roadmap presentation expected from Bagchi.

holdings.name: Kotak Mahindra Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: RBI approved the appointment of Anup Kumar Saha as MD & CEO for three years effective January 1, 2027.
Provisional figures for Q2 FY27 showed net advances reaching ₹5,77,094 crore and deposits at ₹6,51,491 crore.

expected.text: Nomura anticipated 17% core PPOP growth for private lenders including Kotak Mahindra Bank in Q2.

seeing.text: Shares rallied up to 15% in a month and hit 52-week highs on the back of healthy deposit and loan data.

holdings.why_it_matters: Kotak is the fund's second largest positive 3-month contributor (+0.560% on a 15.77% gain), softening broader losses in the 29.8% Financials segment.

watch.text: Board meeting and earnings call scheduled for October 24, 2026 to review Q2 FY27 results.

holdings.name: Reliance Industries Ltd

what_changed.text: Subsidiary Jio Platforms filed its Red Herring Prospectus for an IPO of up to 27 crore shares with a price band of ₹1,065 to ₹1,119.
The company entered discussions regarding Venezuelan oil production arrangements.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 2.42% weight, Reliance's -9.15% 3-month decline shaved -0.221% from returns, driving the bulk of performance for the 4.7% Energy & Utilities allocation.

watch.text: Opening of subscriptions for the Jio Platforms IPO on October 21, 2026.

holdings.name: State Bank of India

what_changed.text: The bank increased lending rates through revisions to EBLR and RLL.
SBI agreed to purchase a 19.8% stake in CareEdge Global IFSC alongside NSEIX.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 2.09% fund weight, SBI dropped -8.14% over 3 months, aligning with declines in ICICI Bank and HDFC Bank.

watch.text: Impact of revised lending rates on loan growth and borrower repayments.

holdings.name: Infosys Ltd

what_changed.text: The company expanded its strategic tie-up with Truist to scale an AI-first Global Capability Center in Hyderabad, adding 1,000 personnel.
Infosys clarified that the U.S. Department of Labor's PERM suspension will have no material impact.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 2.01% portfolio weight, its 4.01% 3-month return provided steady support to the fund's 10.8% Technology allocation.

watch.text: Announcement of second-quarter financial results on October 23, 2026.

holdings.name: Sona BLW Precision Forgings Ltd

what_changed.text: The company mutually ended its Chennai captive solar project agreement with Seeyel Renewables due to altered power requirements.

holdings.why_it_matters: A 1.99% weight combined with an 11.12% 3-month return yielded +0.221% in contribution, supporting Consumer Discretionary returns.

watch.text: Q2 FY27 earnings call and board meeting on October 26, 2026.

holdings.name: Bharat Forge Ltd

what_changed.text: The board approved a ₹240 crore investment in subsidiary KSSL to fund an ammunition facility.
Bharat Forge entered a long-term supply agreement with Pratt & Whitney Canada for critical aerospace engine parts.

holdings.why_it_matters: A sharp -18.58% 3-month return at a 1.93% weight made it the fund's largest detractor (-0.359% contribution), offsetting gains within Industrials and Discretionary.

watch.text: Execution of KSSL's rights issue funding and progress on the ammunition production unit.

holdings.name: Lenskart Solutions Ltd.

what_changed.text: The company was served a customs demand of ₹13.17 crore covering duty and penalty on imported optical frames.
Large block deals worth approximately ₹1,895 to ₹1,985 crore occurred, reportedly involving Alpha Wave selling equity.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 1.90% fund weight, its 18.14% 3-month surge generated +0.345% in contribution, acting as the fund's third largest positive contributor.

watch.text: Board meeting on November 4, 2026 to approve Q2 and half-year unaudited results.

holdings.name: Mankind Pharma Ltd.

what_changed.text: The board sanctioned an acquisition of a 70% stake in ACTx for €48 million, alongside an additional investment commitment up to €45 million.

holdings.why_it_matters: Its -12.18% 3-month decline on a 1.85% position reduced fund performance by -0.225%, weakening the 7.8% Healthcare sleeve.

watch.text: Integration milestones and development progress in ACTx's cell therapy pipeline.

portfolio.statement: The fund experienced a 3-month return of -2.46%, weighed down by banking margin pressures and manufacturing drag despite strong individual winners in materials and retail.
interp: Heavy financial exposure (29.8%) created mixed results, where Kotak Mahindra Bank's gains were outweighed by corrections in HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, and SBI.
Consumer Discretionary (15.1%) demonstrated wide internal divergence, with strong runs in Lenskart and Sona BLW offset by Bharat Forge's drop.
portfolio.line: Performance was hindered by large-cap banking margin drag and auto-component weakness despite strong single-stock mid-cap winners.

drivers.text: Kotak Mahindra Bank rose 15.77% following solid loan and deposit growth data, contributing +0.560%.
Lenskart Solutions gained 18.14%, adding +0.345% to returns despite block deals and a customs notice.
Bharat Forge tumbled -18.58%, detracting -0.359% and becoming the portfolio's deepest individual drag.
HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank fell -8.44% and -5.42% respectively as margin compression concerns weighed on sentiment.

themes.title: Private Bank Divergence
themes.text: Lenders diverged as Kotak Mahindra Bank rallied on preliminary expansion data while HDFC Bank faced margin pressure and ICICI Bank experienced a 340 bps CASA drop.

themes.title: Consumer Discretionary Dispersion
themes.text: Component supplier Bharat Forge corrected sharply despite winning aerospace contracts, while auto supplier Sona BLW and eyewear retailer Lenskart posted double-digit gains.

macro.why: Rising funding costs, CASA dilution, and selective lending rate revisions are influencing profitability across major credit institutions.
Long-term international supply contracts and defense capacity expansions are shifting operational focus beyond domestic automotive demand.

priced_in.text: Net interest margin compression across HDFC Bank following Q2 results.
Strong loan and deposit momentum in Kotak Mahindra Bank leading into Q2 results.

could_change.title: Jio Platforms Public Listing
could_change.text: The market reception of Jio Platforms' IPO subscription opening on October 21, 2026 could recalibrate Reliance Industries' valuation.

could_change.title: Leadership Transitions in Banking
could_change.text: Execution of upcoming leadership transitions at Kotak Mahindra Bank and HDFC Bank may alter operational priorities.

portfolio.risk_note: A 29.8% allocation to Financials leaves the fund highly exposed to systemic banking margin pressures, though a 27.2% top-10 concentration keeps single-stock risk moderate.
